preamble: Middle Chinese [ts] was palatalized to [tɕ] before [i, y] in Mandarin (Qing-period 'jiān-tuán' dialects merged these with the palatalized velars). Before other vowels [ts] was retained.
sources: Pulleyblank, E. G. (1984). Middle Chinese: A Study in Historical Phonology. University of British Columbia Press.
Norman, J. (1988). Chinese. Cambridge University Press.
